scenario: Choose a conversation starter for a long car ride; user wants reflection, not personal questions.
mechanism: Offer an impersonal reflective prompt.

scenario: Discuss a supplied expression 'a heavy silence'; user asks whether it means the room was loud.
mechanism: Explain figurative emotional weight without assuming a specific cause.

scenario: Plan a drawing session using a single pencil; discuss subject and composition before suggesting shading techniques.
mechanism: Remember the limited tool after two exchanges.

scenario: Explore whether to tell a friend about hurt feelings; user clarifies they first want to understand their own reaction.
mechanism: Pause communication planning in favor of reflection.

scenario: Create a fictional conversation at a bus stop; user changes the encounter from strangers to former classmates who barely remember each other.
mechanism: Adjust familiarity while preserving uncertainty about shared memories.

scenario: Arrange a set of blankets; user says one is decorative and should stay out of regular use.
mechanism: Separate display from functional storage.

scenario: Explain 'generous' through a nonmaterial example; user asks whether giving time can count.
mechanism: Extend meaning beyond money or gifts.

scenario: Develop a fictional traveler who cannot read the local signs; discuss their destination and companion before navigating a scene.
mechanism: Avoid having the traveler read signs unaided after two exchanges.

scenario: Discuss an awkward compliment to a friend; user clarifies they have not said it yet.
mechanism: Treat wording as prospective rather than suggesting repair for an event.

scenario: Plan a tabletop arrangement for a card game; user adds that one player needs clear sight of every card.
mechanism: Revise seating and layout without assuming a diagnosis.

scenario: Choose a caption for a personal sketch; user wants to describe the mood without claiming the scene is real.
mechanism: Maintain the fictional status of the image.

scenario: Interpret the phrase 'I might drop by'; user asks whether it is a firm promise.
mechanism: Preserve tentative commitment.

scenario: Imagine a fictional orchestra rehearsal without a conductor; discuss the players and piece before deciding how they begin together.
mechanism: Maintain absent conductor after two exchanges.

scenario: Discuss differing standards for a tidy room; user says both people share the space and neither owns it outright.
mechanism: Consider negotiated shared needs without assigning unilateral authority.

scenario: Develop a story about a misplaced note; user decides the note was never lost, only put in an unexpected place.
mechanism: Revise the premise without claiming a culprit.

scenario: Choose an evening activity; user clarifies that quiet conversation is welcome despite wanting a quiet evening.
mechanism: Distinguish low noise from complete silence.

scenario: Explore 'patient' as a personality description; user asks if patience means never feeling frustrated.
mechanism: Distinguish behavior from the absence of emotion.

scenario: Plan a fictional picnic scene with a cloth that must stay dry; discuss food and characters before introducing a spill.
mechanism: Keep the cloth's constraint in mind after two exchanges without claiming it cannot get wet.

scenario: Reflect on a missed social cue; user clarifies they learned about it from a friend, not from the person affected.
mechanism: Keep secondhand information distinct from the affected person's perspective.

scenario: Troubleshoot difficulty finding a particular page in a paper notebook; user clarifies the pages have no numbers.
mechanism: Avoid page-number instructions and suggest a reversible indexing method.
